attempts.text:
**Key constraints**
- The only valid drop-off point is Naukunda shelter. Syaphru school is not designated.
- The only road to Syaphru school (from Dupcheshwar) is closed, so the four children there can't be reached and must be deferred.
- With the direct Naukunda–Dupcheshwar road buried, reaching Dupcheshwar means going via Shivapuri market, which takes 40 minutes each way.
- The Gosaikunda–Shivapuri road is also buried, so each trip has to return to the shelter.

**Rescue or defer**

| Group | Trips | Driving (min) | Deferral penalty avoided |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 elderly, Dupcheshwar | 2 round trips at 80 min each | 160 | 350 |
| 4 adults, Benighat | 1 round trip via Gosaikunda | 56 | 80 |
| 3 adults, Gosaikunda | 1 round trip | 40 | 60 |
| 4 children, Syaphru school | Unreachable | 0 | None (240 penalty) |

Every reachable person is worth rescuing because each trip costs less than the penalties it avoids. The 7 adults need at least two trips because the car carries four, so 96 minutes is the least driving for them.

<plan>
defer syaphru-school child 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market dupcheshwar-market
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 dupcheshwar-market shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market dupcheshwar-market
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 dupcheshwar-market shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-care-home
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home benighat-market
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 benighat-market gosaikunda-care-home
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-care-home
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
</plan>

**Cost:** 256 minutes of driving + 240 in deferral penalties = 496

The four children at Syaphru school should be the priority for the next wave, or for any non-road option such as a helicopter, because no road access remains.

COST: 496
